description: Source code for ResponsePollingHandler class managing background response polling with Redis cache, including methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting polling states, as well as utility functions for polling logic based on model and provider.

classes.name: ResponsePollingHandler
classes.description: Handles polling-based responses with Redis cache, providing methods to create, update, retrieve, cancel, and delete polling states.

methods.name: generate_polling_id
methods.description: Generates a unique polling ID with a specific prefix.

methods.name: is_polling_id
methods.description: Checks if a given response ID is a polling ID based on prefix.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Constructs Redis cache key for a polling ID.

methods.name: create_initial_state
methods.description: Creates and stores initial polling response state in Redis, following OpenAI response object format.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Updates the polling state in Redis with new status, output, usage, and other response fields.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves current polling state from Redis.

methods.name: cancel_polling
methods.description: Marks a polling request as cancelled.

methods.name: delete_polling
methods.description: Deletes a polling request from Redis cache.
